messages.author: d4fb714af6c90658
messages.subject: RStan print() - Trivial request
parts:
I've modified the print.stanfit() function in stanfit-class.R by adding a new parameter, verbose = TRUE, to suppress the first four and the last five lines (blank lines included) by setting verbose=FALSE. The change is trivial (if (verbose) { ... }).
I wished a shorter output when inserting print(<stanfit>) statements in a LaTeX+Sweave/knitr document. Eventually, the "verbose" parameter could be useful to someone else...

Sergio

PS:
a) I suggest this change here, not in Stan Developer's list, because as far I can understand that list is about Stan, not RStan.
b) Developer? Me? Don't joke ;-)

parts:
Ok. I'll try to use:

display <- function(x, pars = x@sim$pars_oi,
                    probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.975), digits_summary = 1, ...) {
    if (x@mode == 1L) {
        cat("Stan model '", x@model_name, "' is of mode 'test_grad'; ",
            "sampling is not conducted. ", sep = '')
        return(invisible(NULL))
    } else if (x@mode == 2L) {
        cat("Stan model '", x@model_name, "' does not contain samples. ", sep = '')
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    cat("Inference for Stan model: ", x@model_name, '. ', sep = '')
    s <- summary(x, pars, probs, ...)$summary
    s[, 'n_eff'] <- round(s[, 'n_eff'], 0)
    print(round(s, digits_summary), ...)
}

Thanks

Sergio
